trips.route_note: Take a direct train from Chennai Central or Egmore to Tirupati in about 3 hours, then a local bus or taxi up the hill to Tirumala for the main temple, which is about 25 km from the town.
trips.tour_query: Tirupati Tirumala temple day trip from Chennai
trips.why: The direct train takes about 3h 10m, and a local bus or taxi covers the last leg up to Tirumala.
know: The main temple at Tirumala draws huge crowds, so book darshan slots online in advance where possible.
Queues can take many hours at peak times, so allow a full day for the round trip.

trips.route_note: Direct trains run from Chennai Egmore to Puducherry in about 3 to 4 hours, and frequent express buses from Koyambedu take a similar time; the French Quarter is a short walk or auto ride from the bus stand.
trips.why: The bus takes about 3h 35m versus about 4h 5m by train, and frequent express buses leave from Koyambedu.
know: The French Quarter is best explored on foot in the early morning or evening.
Plan a full day or more if you want to combine the French Quarter with the beaches and the Auroville area.

trips.route_note: Take a train from Chennai Egmore or Chennai Beach toward Kanchipuram Road station, or a frequent bus from Koyambedu; temples are a short auto ride from the station or bus stand.
trips.tour_query: Kanchipuram temples day trip from Chennai
trips.why: The bus takes about 1h 40m versus about 2h 39m by train, and it runs frequently from Koyambedu.
know: Known for its temples and handwoven silk saris, with weaving workshops and shops in town.
Many temples close for a midday break, so plan visits for morning or late afternoon.
